Home.heroText: TERAN tea for quiet moments, warm conversations and everyday rituals.
Home.categoriesText: Black, green, white or herbal — find the tea that suits your mood.
Home.storyTitle: Tea is the art of slowing down
Home.storyText: To us, tea is more than a drink. It is a habit that slows the day, gathers people around one table and turns an ordinary moment into a ritual. TERAN aims to bring that feeling into every pack.
Home.valueNaturalText: We respect the taste and aroma that nature provides.
Home.valueQualityText: We treat every product with care.
Home.valueEleganceText: We bring grace to the everyday tea ritual.
Home.brewingText: Every type of tea needs its own temperature and time. General guidance is below — exact instructions are on each product page.
Home.brewingNote: General guidance. Follow the instructions on the pack.
Home.businessTitle: TERAN for cafés, restaurants, hotels and retailers
Home.businessText: Send us a wholesale or partnership enquiry — our team will get back to you.
